info.title: trello (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Trello REST API. Authentication via query params: key={apiKey}&token={userToken}. Board IDs, card IDs, and list IDs are 24-character alphanumeric strings.

get.description: Retrieve all boards belonging to a member. Pass memberId='me' to get the authenticated user's boards. Useful for discovering board IDs by name before querying lists or cards.

parameters.name: memberId
parameters.description: The member ID, or 'me' to refer to the authenticated user.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Scope of boards to return: all, open, closed, members, organization, public (defaults to open).

get.summary: Retrieve all lists present on a given Trello board.
get.description: Retrieve all lists present on a given Trello board.

parameters.name: filter

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Scope of cards to return: all, closed, none, open, visible (defaults to all).

put.description: Edit properties of an existing Trello card. Only include the fields you wish to change; all others remain unchanged.
